cases.name: Ashley Kay Harlan
cases.about: Her obituary said, "After moving to Manhattan, KS, Ashley began ministering to survivors of sex trafficking and abuse. Ashley was wholeheartedly committed to following Jesus wherever she felt him lead her. She loved God with all she was. Ashley was expecting a baby boy who also passed with her."
